scenario_text: I have been feeling lonely and disconnected from everyone lately.
I have been feeling anxious and overwhelmed for several weeks.
I keep having panic attacks and I do not know what to do.
I recently lost my job and I feel hopeless about the future.
I am caring for a family member with a long-term illness and feel emotionally exhausted.
I have been struggling with insomnia and poor sleep for several months.
My relationship ended recently and I am finding it very difficult to cope.
I feel completely hopeless and like I cannot keep doing this anymore.
